owner_and_capability: Third slice of #4076 across Device Fleet, Organisation & Tenancy, Grade Transition, Enrollment, Facilities, School Calendar, Timetable and Data Import: owners read their own setting key names, generate provisioning secrets through securityruntime, normalize class names through schoolstructure, and reach the presence and timetable legacy views through consumer-owned ports the root binds via new projection compose packages; test suites use the shared fixtures and owner vocabularies instead of foreign models.
affected_tables: None: no DDL or table ownership change.
atomic_cutover: Code cutover without a new rule or policy epoch. The organizationtenancy secrets adapter is deleted; api.provisioningSecrets calls securityruntime.DeviceAPIKey and RandomLowerAlphanumeric. modules/presenceprojection/compose and modules/timetableprojection/compose name the projection readers for the root; api.PlanningQuery serves the offering-change planning reads and a CountSourceEnrollments port serves the enrollment deletion preview in the owner's transaction. Budgets fall (enrollment compose 848 -> 823); the two new projection compose packages start their own measurements. 18 keys retire.
tests: Enrollment, Device Fleet, Facilities, School Calendar portal, Timetable, Grade Transition and Data Import suites keep their assertions; a regression test covers the new CountSourceEnrollments port.
